Name: Seasonal Flower Vase
Author: Mephistokles
Description:
I always disliked the dried sunflower, but never found a replacer for it. So I tried to do it myself - and this is the result.

My very first mod.

A simple replacer for the ugly sunflowers, that changes the apperance with the season.

I mainly did this mod for myself, but maybe some others have a need for it, too.

This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Seasonal Flower Vase
Manifest.Description: Replaces Dried Sunflowers with a Seasonal Flower Vase.
